events.title: The Tree of Eternity
events.summary: The Tree of Eternity is an immersive, interactive installation that explores remembrance, loss, and the enduring presence of those we have loved. The installation centers on a projected tree surrounded by interactive terminal pods that control its structure. Visitors approach interactive pods positioned throughout the gallery space, where they are invited to recall memories of people or experiences throughout their lives. Depending on the kiosk they interact with, different effects will be present on the projected tree. As more visitors’ memories are inputted, the tree’s visuals adapt and change form, demonstrating that our memories persist with us. Projection mapping creates ethereal visuals accompanied by atmospheric audio. Even when visitors aren't actively engaging with the kiosks, the system generates ambient transmissions, suggesting that the tree—and the memories it embodies—continues to live and grow. The installation creates a dialogue between life and death, presence and absence, individual memory and collective remembrance, inviting participants to contribute to a living memorial that persists beyond any single moment of grief or reflection.

events.title: Awakening the Dragon–Showcasing the Building and Performance of an Asian Icon
events.summary: Experience a curated experience of the imaginary, featuring a lightly sci-fi, magnificent work of art--the LRCCS Fortune and Longevity Dragon, a 25-ft long, Asian-inspired full-body dragon sculpture for use in the traditional "dragon dance" crafted by renowned international artist Zhen Guo with U-M faculty arts lecturer Raymond Wetzel, artist Jeri Rosenberg, students, and volunteers The exhibition highlights the story of the dragon's fabrication and its impact on community.. An iconic symbol of inclusivity, strength, and courage, this newly imagined U-M dragon, with its futuristic flair, technological creativity and sustainable materials, invites students and the entire community to re-envision a classic cultural symbol for contemporary times. Presented by the Lieberthal-Rogel Center for Chinese Studies. This project was made possible by grants from the University of Michigan Arts Initiative and the Office of the Provost, Global Engagement. Additional funding was provided by ArtsEngine, Center for World Performance Studies, Stearns Collection of Musical Instruments, and U.S. Department of Education. With support from Asian Languages and Cultures, International Institute, James and Anne Duderstadt Center, Nam Center for Korean Studies, Residential College, School of Kinesiology, School of Music, Theatre & Dance, Taubman College, University of Michigan Library, University of Michigan Museum of Art, and Women’s and Gender Studies Department. *If there is anything we can do to make this event accessible to you, please contact us at cstep@umich.edu. events.title: Orpheus Singers
events.summary: The Orpheus Singers performs a program of choral works conducted by members of the graduate choral conducting studio. The concert concludes with *The Promise of America*, presented in collaboration with the Department of Musical Theatre. *The Promise of America* is a song cycle written for choir, soloists, and chamber orchestra by Kim D. Sherman (music/ vocal arrangements) and Christine Toy Johnson (words) that illuminates the impact of various constitutional amendments on the American people. Aiming to inspire the upholding of the U.S. Constitution as the cornerstone of American democracy, included are reflections on the freedom of speech, marriage equality, public school funding, prohibition, voting rights, Presidential term limits, due process, ramifications of the Second Amendment, and more. PROGRAM *I Can Tell the World*, arr. Moses Hogan *Plain-Chant for America*, William Grant Still *Frostiana*, Randall Thompson *The Promise of America*, Christine Toy Johnson, Kim D. Sherman

events.title: THEATRE l She Kills Monsters
events.summary: Planet Ant Theatre presents SHE KILLS MONSTERS by Qui Nguyen, December 4-19, 2026, at Ant Hall. When Agnes Evans loses her teenage sister Tilly, she realizes she barely knew her. Tilly's Dungeons & Dragons notebook pulls Agnes into a fantastical world of epic quests, homicidal fairies, snarling ogres, and 90s pop culture as she tries to reconnect with her sister and find the courage she never knew she had. Equal parts comedy, heartfelt drama, and action-packed adventure, the play celebrates the power of great storytelling and the geek and warrior in all of us. Content advisory: Strong language, stage combat, sexual references, and themes of grief, bullying, and suicide. Recommended for ages 13+. She Kills Monsters is presented by arrangement with Concord Theatricals on behalf of Samuel French, Inc. For more information, visit www.concordtheatricals.com.

featuredEvents.title: The American G Bugle: Music and Innovations from 1892-1976
featuredEvents.summary: Explore the evolution of the G bugle through historical insights, live demonstrations, and performances. Tubist Wesley DeCasere will discuss the instrument's technological advancements and its changing role in American musical life.

evidence.description: How did a niche valveless instrument evolve into a widespread, versatile musical voice? Through historical insights, live demonstrations, and performances using instruments from the Stearns Collection and the Marching Pageantry Arts Museum, tubist Wesley DeCasere discusses the G bugle's technological evolution and its changing role in American musical life.

evidence.description: Last Call Improv takes over Thursday nights at 9:30 PM for a wild, dynamic mix of styles and forms. Following right after the regular Thursday show, this late-night staple features a rotating lineup of performance troupes hand-picked from open submissions. The evening is anchored by Wanted Live , a featured headliner performing a TJ and Dave-style long-form improv set, where grounded, authentic human behavior drives the comedy. Whether you are looking for experimental forms or high-energy laughs, Last Call Improv offers an unpredictable, one-of-a-kind experience every single week.
